name: lynxce-shopping-assistant
description: Search a product and get the post-coupon price plus a ready-to-open deal link, with cross-platform comparison and budget planning.

displayDescription.zh: 搜商品直接给出券后价与可下单的领券链接，同时做跨平台比价、优惠核算和购物清单排序。
displayDescription.en: Search a product and get the post-coupon price plus a ready-to-open deal link, with cross-platform comparison and list planning.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我找降噪耳机，直接给领券链接
defaultInitPrompt.en: Find me noise-cancelling headphones and send the deal links

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我找降噪耳机，直接给领券链接
quickPrompts.en: Find me noise-cancelling headphones and send the deal links

quickPrompts.zh: 这两个链接哪个到手价更低
quickPrompts.en: Which of these two links has the lower final price

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把这份清单按预算排个优先级
quickPrompts.en: Prioritize this shopping list within my budget
